purpose: Chinese channel and group text under reviewed promotional-intent policy. Preserve normal sharing, official benefits, and reviewed channel-related service/package information. No general channel-topic inference or ad-free guarantee.

publicSources.license: No explicit dataset license located; raw data not redistributed.

publicSources.usage: Only message_content ham/spam marked by admin_dashboard/group_admin; identifiers excluded
publicSources.license: No explicit dataset license located; raw data not redistributed.

publicSources.usage: 87 development probes relabeled for promotional intent, including preserving anti-fraud discussion. No raw text redistributed or directly trained.

training.checkpointSelection: Public validation precision >= .985 and FPR <= .005, then domain false positives, domain recall, public recall. Test labels never fitted.
training.grouping: Normalized deduplication, conflicting labels removed, near-duplicate TF-IDF char 3/4-grams grouped before split; not a channel-level split.

thresholdCalibration.method: Per-epoch validation-only fine grid; checkpoint selection by public precision/FPR constraints and authored-domain protection/recall. Public test reused as a longitudinal benchmark, not a fresh external evaluation.

additionalRejectedStage.reason: Authored domain validation recall regressed; not selected for shipping

previousDeviceAdaptation.policy: Normal software sharing, open source recommendations, official free credits and benefits retained; commercial promotion spans reviewed independently.

rejectedStages.reason: Final reviewed policy preserves related service posts; restart from pre-exposure checkpoint

abortedStages: 14: isolated navigation label conflict after normalization corrected
deviceAdaptation.previouslyHeldOut26: Inspected at v12, then reclassified as development/training; no unseen-accuracy claim
deviceAdaptation.policy: Preserve normal sharing, tutorials, official benefits, and the reviewed channel-related ITIN services/eSIM package information; remove other commercial promotion spans. This is a reviewed sample policy, not automatic channel-topic understanding.

evaluation.warning: Public spam labels are noisy and differ from promotional intent. Scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities. Development regression results are not unseen generalization accuracy. End-to-end projection includes language/context/range safeguards.

nativeDevelopmentRegression.scope: 426 development cases: old 322 plus 97 reviewed new device texts plus 7 authored stress cases. Full annotated advertising spans must disappear; contact-only removal fails.

physicalDevice.scope: Production model/tokenizer/policy/projector in an Xcode diagnostic app; not an installed complete IPA upgrade. Includes shared-cache reuse.

privacy: No network or message upload in inference. Real-device messages and raw corpora are excluded from the repository. Classification outputs cannot generate original training messages.
limitations: Chinese only; unsupported languages preserved for explicit rules
No image, video or audio content recognition
Adversarial obfuscation, very short coded messages and advertorials can be missed
Normal content can be misclassified; originals remain stored and can be revealed
No self-training from predictions or automatic remote model updates
Channel topic is not inferred automatically; service-post preservation is based on reviewed training examples, not arbitrary context awareness.

inference.wholeCardConsensus: Complete text and every meaningful blank-line block >= .99, at least two blocks >= span threshold, no substantive normal content or protected code. Only complete-card cuts use this floor.
inference.privacy: On-device, bounded background inference; no network requests.
inference.inlineNavigation: Distinct menu links classified independently; adjacent same-target entity fragments coalesced; normal navigation protected; short-label expansion requires own score >=.99 plus adjacent/combined agreement.
inference.sameDestination: Whitespace-adjacent repeated bare destination can follow a fully removed matching link; disabled for manual reviewed snapshots.
